description: Source code for the V1Function class, a wrapper for V1 scalar functions in Apache Spark, implementing lazy loading and function invocation patterns.

classes.name: V1Function
classes.description: A wrapper class for V1 scalar functions with lazy resource loading, providing function invocation and metadata.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Invokes the wrapped function with given arguments, triggering resource loading on first call.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Method from UnboundFunction interface, not used in V1Function, throws internal error if called.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the function from ExpressionInfo.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Returns the description/usage of the function from ExpressionInfo.
